description:
Leave the mouse on the desk. Sofatap turns your iPhone or iPad into a touchpad and keyboard for your own computer, including the one connected to your living-room TV.

MOVE, CLICK AND SCROLL
With the default preset, slide one finger to move the pointer, tap to click, or hold for 0.3 seconds and move to drag. Scroll with two fingers or the strip inside the touchpad’s right edge. Choose a gesture preset or customize taps, double-taps and holds in gesture settings.

TYPE OR DICTATE
Use the iPhone keyboard or supported on-device dictation. Compatible native Windows and Mac text fields synchronize typing, edits and recognized speech as you go. Other fields use a draft you review and send. Sofatap does not append an extra Return after your text. Line breaks you include may be handled as Enter by the destination app.

SCAN, NAME, SWITCH
Install the Sofatap receiver and scan its QR code. Current receivers identify the device automatically. Save a name that makes sense to you, then switch between saved devices. You can rename or remove a pairing on your iPhone at any time.

YOUR DEVICES, DIRECTLY CONNECTED
Input travels over an encrypted connection on your local network. No Sofatap account, cloud relay, subscription or in-app purchase is required. Built-in dictation stays on the iPhone and requires a supported device and language. The computer's picture remains on its TV or monitor; Sofatap does not stream the screen.

REQUIREMENTS
An iPhone with iOS 17 or later, or an iPad with iPadOS 17 or later and the free Sofatap receiver for Windows, Mac or Linux. Both devices must be on a reachable home network, and the computer must be awake and unlocked. Mac requires macOS 15 or later and Accessibility permission. Linux support depends on the desktop and its input permissions; Wayland is experimental. Unsupported fields, including many browser and custom controls, use review-and-send; Linux and older receivers use this mode.

TV adapters in the app are development previews; physical TV and app compatibility is not yet qualified. This version provides manual control, not autonomous AI operation.

Receiver downloads and setup:
https://github.com/chekusu/sofatap/releases/tag/v0.8.1-beta.1
https://github.com/chekusu/sofatap/blob/main/docs/app-store/support.md
promotionalText: Use your iPhone as a touchpad and keyboard for your computer. Scan to pair, name your devices, then tap, scroll, type or dictate from the sofa.
